title.narrative: Programme for country partnerhsip for the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: In order to scale up the achieved results within the UNIDO Country Programme for the Republic of Moldova 2019-2024, the Government of the Republic of Moldova has requested to transition from the CP to the PCP framework through an official letter of request of the Prime Minister of the Republic of Moldova, H.E. Mr. Dorin Recean dated 7 June 2023 addressed to UNIDO Director General. The Prime Minister has indicated the Government#s interest to further scale up cooperation to achieve tangible results in the areas of industrial policymaking, development of the industrial infrastructure, enhancing economic diversification, modernization and greening of priority sectors and value chains. Furthermore, the Prime Minister confirmed the readiness of the Government of the Republic of Moldova to assume full ownership of the process by establishing a dedicated team of technical assistants and expressed the readiness to provide leadership in resource mobilization and coordination with development and funding partners, as well as Government institutions and other national counterparts to ensure the strategic orientation and consistent implementation of the PCP.
